displayTitle: The Rebel Alliance - Ships of the Fleet
synopsis: The Rebel Alliance: Ships of the Fleet is an 8-page pop-up book about the ships and fighters of the Alliance to Restore the Republic. The page count is deceptive, as it has no less than five fold-outs. In addition to pop-up images, it contains pictures, drawn images, diagrams, technical specifications, and text.
title: The Rebel Alliance - Ships of the Fleet
